notablePrerequisites:
Instill Energy attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can tap to produce {G}.
description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Cast Frog Tongue by paying {G}, attaching it to Incubation Druid.
Frog Tongue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Frog Tongue trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Instill Energy from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, attaching it to Incubation Druid.
Instill Energy enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Frog Tongue from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
